āyāso vā jyate mūlam ekāṃgam api saṃtyajet ||
marikṣāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |

yuktaṃ te
nānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ ||
yathā hi teṃ jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |

saṃ
rakṣase jītam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayikṣe kapotakaṃ ||
yad atra yukta manyatte karttuṃ śyenāsu tad vada ||

āhāraḥ sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavati janeśva
ra ||
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||
na śakyaṃte nedriyaṇy arthai rājan varttayitu ciraṃ |

na tv āhā
ravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit ||
bhakṣād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||

visṛjya kā
yaṃ yāsyaṃti | yathā nam apunarbhavaṃ ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati

rekṣamāṇaḥ kapotatra tvā
bahūn prāṇān ne rakṣasi |
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmo paraṃtapa |

avirodhī ca yo dharmo sa dharmaḥ sadbhi
r ucyate
te sya virodhe dharmasya vicitya gurulāghavaṃ ||
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmavinirnayaṃ ||
nāto bhūyaḥ paraṃ dharma kaścad anyo sti vidyate |

va
ram ekasya bhītasya dattāsth abhayadakṣiṇā ||
na tu viprasyahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ ||

ayaṃ sarvabhūte
bhya yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||

hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ su
lalā bhuvi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtahitapradaḥ ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītāyabhapradānasya kṣeya eva na vidyate ||
dattam yajñas tapas tapta tīrthasevā stutaṃ tathā ||

sarvāṇy abhayadānasya
kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtaṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivim imāṃ ||

abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhya tayor abhayado
dhikaḥ ||
api tyajed rājyam imaṃ vā pi dustyajaṃ
nar tv ima bhayaṃ saṃtrastaṃ tyakṣe dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ
kiṃcit | tena janmani janmani |
bheveyam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśakaḥ ||

na hy ahaṃ kāmayed rājyaṃ na sva
rga na punarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhamagnānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ ||

yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛ
tā ||
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||

ya yavaṃ vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ
kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam apy aparair api ||

śyenāḥ kapotān_ khaditi śrutir eṣā sanāta
nī ||
mā rājan_ sāratāṃ jñātvā kaṃdalīskaṃbham āruha ||

nāham uchāstramārgeṇa kvacid va
rtte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ ||
sarvasatveṣu ya dānaṃm ekasatve ca yā dayā |

sarva
satvapradānāt tu dayaikātra viśiṣyate ||
sarve vedā na tat_ kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvatīrthābhiṣeka
ś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥr ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādarśitapathāno brahma
loke vrajaṃti te ||
gachatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||

yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva
ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni stvovarāṇi cape narāḥ ||
ātmavatparirakṣaṃti yāṃti te paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇanaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

rājyaṃ śi
vināṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hy annyaṃ varya iitvā kapotakaṃ ||
yadi rājan_ kapotena sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me ||
anugrāham imaṃ manye yan māṃsenābhiyācase ||
etat te haṃ prayaccāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś cirād vadati śyena vā ||
mama tu priyam evaitat | kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

adhru
veṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināsina |
dhruva yo nārjaye dharmaṃ saṃ śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||

yadi pratyupakā
rāya deho
tasmāt kapotana | dhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā samaṃ ||

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śye
nabhiyācase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tavāpi ca vihaṃgama ||

evam uktā svamāṃsā
ni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||

tyaktvātmasukhabhogachā

py atiricyate ||

m aṃcit ||

nā

nāvarttate punaḥ ||

kā kathā ||

ti ||

ne hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ ||

paropakā
ravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||

pārthiva |

galayaṃ ||
ratum iṣṭvā tu mumude devac ciraṃ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||

sa vidhūyeha pā
vāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||
